recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to cds-hooks-service display, definition, or lifecycle status should be made through THO/UTG unless the core Endpoint value set stops composing from the THO endpoint-connection-type CodeSystem.
issue_request: FHIR-17593 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by Patient Administration and requested adding cds-hooks-service, display CDS Hooks Service, and a CDS Hooks base-URL definition to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/endpoint-connection-type.
initial_application: No core source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17593 was found. Jira says a UTG submission was created and the issue was applied with HTA; UP-344 is the Proposal Implemented UTG ticket that lists FHIR-17593 and http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/endpoint-connection-type as part of the PA terminology change set.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini, Endpoint.connectionType binds to the core endpoint connection type ValueSet, and that ValueSet composes all codes from the external THO endpoint-connection-type CodeSystem. The current THO CodeSystem contains cds-hooks-service with the requested display and definition, and build.fhir.org renders that code in the endpoint ValueSet expansion. Related Endpoint terminology issues FHIR-36589, FHIR-38798, and FHIR-39600 affect the same code-system family but do not conflict with the CDS Hooks service code.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core source is already correct because it includes the THO CodeSystem that now carries cds-hooks-service, so adding a redundant explicit code include to the core ValueSet would be unnecessary and risk divergence from THO.
